answer_2.quote: ...Model labels have high accuracy with 80.41% against majority and 89.53% on the unanimous examples. The κ coefficient between model labels and majority and unanimous subsets is also high (70.53% and 84.17% respectively)...

answer_4.quote: ...Each of the 500 generated examples was annotated with an NLI label by three of the paper's authors. The average Cohen's κ score between annotators is 67.97%, indicating substantial agreement. A majority label (2 out of 3 annotators) was obtained in 490 examples, and we use these as a human-annotated test set...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assigned NLI labels to each example; majority voting was used to determine the final label.
